title: TrustBridge Action Inputs
description:
JSON Schema for trustbridge-action input configuration. Every property corresponds to an input declared in action.yml. Integrators can validate their workflow `with:` block against this schema in CI to catch drift before runtime failures occur on assignment day.

See docs/USAGE.md for a ready-to-use CI validation snippet.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for Horizon API requests.

retry_base_delay_ms.description: Base delay in milliseconds for exponential backoff.

asset_code.description: Asset code to check trustline for.

min_trustline_limit.description: Minimum trustline limit required for the configured asset. Leave empty to skip.

assignee_address_map.description: JSON object or file path mapping GitHub usernames to Stellar G-addresses.

fail_on_missing.description: Fail the workflow step when checks do not pass (true) or only warn (false).

debug_mode.description: Enable extra action logs for troubleshooting.

sticky_comment.description: Update TrustBridge's previous comment instead of posting a new one each run.

wait_until_funded.description: Poll Horizon until the account becomes funded.

wait_until_funded_timeout_ms.description: Maximum total polling time for the account to become funded, in ms.

wait_until_funded_interval_ms.description: Delay between funded-account polling attempts, in ms.

horizon_url_fallback.description: Optional fallback Horizon API base URL for cross-region resilience.

horizon_cache_ttl_ms.description: Time-to-live for the in-memory Horizon account cache, in ms. 0 disables caching.

rpc_fallback_url.description: Optional secondary/fallback Horizon or RPC URL if primary fails.

horizon_max_requests.description: Global cap on Horizon requests per run (0 = unlimited).

retry_max_delay_ms.description: Maximum backoff delay in milliseconds for Horizon retries.

use_cache.description: Cache successful Horizon responses in job memory.

allow_cross_network_fallback.description: Allow fallback URL across different Stellar networks (testnet/mainnet).

log_inputs.description: Emit a structured JSON log record of all resolved action inputs (redacted) at run start.

trustbridge_config_path.description: Path to a consumer trustbridge.yml config file supplying default input values.

github_token.description: GitHub token used to post issue comments. Requires issues:write permission.

assets_json.description: JSON array of additional assets to validate trustlines for.

sep0007_deep_links.description: Emit SEP-0007 wallet deep links (web+stellar:pay) in the comment.

auto_wallet_labels.description: Automatically apply a wallet state label to the issue.

sep0007_origin_domain.description: Optional origin domain embedded in SEP-0007 URIs (SEP-0007 section 3.4).

snooze_window_minutes.description: Time window in minutes to suppress duplicate failure comments on the same issue.

force_comment.description: Bypass snooze logic and force an immediate comment post.

home_domain_check_enabled.description: Enable the optional SEP-0001 home domain alignment check.

expected_home_domain.description: The domain the issuer's on-chain home_domain must match (case-insensitive).

home_domain_check_mode.description: Whether a home-domain failure blocks the overall result: 'warn' or 'strict'.

check_ledger_freshness.description: Check Horizon ledger freshness before the account check.

max_ledger_lag_seconds.description: Maximum allowed lag in seconds between Horizon's latest ledger close time and now.

ledger_freshness_fail_on_stale.description: When true, a stale ledger response fails the check instead of only warning.
